title: Resolving CO (2-1) in z ∼ 1.6 Gas-rich Cluster Galaxies with ALMA: Rotating Molecular Gas Disks with Possible Signatures of Gas Stripping
question: Are molecular gas disks in z~1.6 cluster galaxies rotating, how large are they compared to stellar disks and the field, and is there evidence for gas stripping?

what.value: Field CO and optical sizes, high-z (PHIBSS)

evidence.quote: The PHIBSS survey contains six star-forming galaxies with sub-arcsecond resolution CO (3–2) imaging

what.value: Low-z field CO and optical sizes (BIMA)

evidence.quote: The BIMA Survey provides 13 galaxies with measured optical disks from $R/J/K/I$ and gas disks from CO (1–0)
The largest compilation of CO sizes of Virgo cluster galaxies is from (cite: Kenney88).

recipe.method: Natural-weighted cubes at 50 and 100 km/s; moment 0 over channels with >~2 sigma emission; moment 1 from pixels >3 sigma
2D elliptical Gaussian fit within 3 sigma region of moment 0; R1/2 = geometric mean of HWHM axes, deconvolved
Extract spectrum within 4 sigma elliptical region, fit Gaussian (double Gaussian for J0225-303); errors from line-free channel rms
L'CO from Solomon05 formula; Mgas = alphaCO L'(2-1)/0.77
GALFIT single-Sérsic fits to HST F160W; compare stellar-to-gas ratios with PHIBSS, BIMA, Virgo; KS test

evidence.quote: with a mean ratio of $1.3\pm0.2$ (using the standard error on the mean)
Our final sample consists of galaxies with gas masses $\sim 1-25\times10^{10}$ ${\rm M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}}$.

not_stated_but_needed: Exact channel ranges for moment maps
Fitting code for 2D Gaussians and spectra
Matharu et al. GALFIT wrapper settings
missing_for_reproduction: Exact fitting code and channel selections
score_reason: Public data and simple methods, but many processing details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the recipe is simple, and the results are numeric.
